title: Recyclarr
description: Sync results and requests to Sonarr and Radarr from the Recyclarr server

panels.title: Server
panels.description: Whether Prometheus reaches the Recyclarr server

panels.title: Successful syncs
panels.description: Syncs in the selected time range in which every instance succeeded

targets.expr: round(sum(increase(recyclarr_sync_job_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", service=~"$service", recyclarr_sync_job_status="succeeded"}[$__range]) or label_replace(min_over_time(recyclarr_sync_job_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", service=~"$service", recyclarr_sync_job_status="succeeded"}[$__range]) unless last_over_time(recyclarr_sync_job_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", service=~"$service", recyclarr_sync_job_status="succeeded"}[1d] offset $__range), "first_sample", "true", "", "")))

panels.title: Partial syncs
panels.description: Syncs in the selected time range in which some instances failed

targets.expr: round(sum(increase(recyclarr_sync_job_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", service=~"$service", recyclarr_sync_job_status="partial"}[$__range]) or label_replace(min_over_time(recyclarr_sync_job_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", service=~"$service", recyclarr_sync_job_status="partial"}[$__range]) unless last_over_time(recyclarr_sync_job_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", service=~"$service", recyclarr_sync_job_status="partial"}[1d] offset $__range), "first_sample", "true", "", "")))

panels.title: Failed syncs
panels.description: Syncs in the selected time range that failed

targets.expr: round(sum(increase(recyclarr_sync_job_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", service=~"$service", recyclarr_sync_job_status="failed"}[$__range]) or label_replace(min_over_time(recyclarr_sync_job_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", service=~"$service", recyclarr_sync_job_status="failed"}[$__range]) unless last_over_time(recyclarr_sync_job_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", service=~"$service", recyclarr_sync_job_status="failed"}[1d] offset $__range), "first_sample", "true", "", "")))

panels.title: Average sync duration
panels.description: Average duration of the syncs in the selected time range

targets.expr: sum(increase(recyclarr_sync_job_duration_seconds_sum{namespace="$namespace", service=~"$service"}[$__range]) or label_replace(min_over_time(recyclarr_sync_job_duration_seconds_sum{namespace="$namespace", service=~"$service"}[$__range]) unless last_over_time(recyclarr_sync_job_duration_seconds_sum{namespace="$namespace", service=~"$service"}[1d] offset $__range), "first_sample", "true", "", "")) / sum(increase(recyclarr_sync_job_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", service=~"$service"}[$__range]) or label_replace(min_over_time(recyclarr_sync_job_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", service=~"$service"}[$__range]) unless last_over_time(recyclarr_sync_job_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", service=~"$service"}[1d] offset $__range), "first_sample", "true", "", ""))

panels.title: Syncs by result
panels.description: Syncs that finished in each interval, by result

targets.expr: sum by (recyclarr_sync_job_status) (increase(recyclarr_sync_job_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", service=~"$service"}[$__rate_interval]) or label_replace(min_over_time(recyclarr_sync_job_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", service=~"$service"}[$__interval]) unless last_over_time(recyclarr_sync_job_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", service=~"$service"}[1d] offset $__interval), "first_sample", "true", "", "")) > 0

panels.title: Sync duration
panels.description: Average duration of the syncs that finished in each interval, by what started them

targets.expr: sum by (recyclarr_sync_job_trigger) (increase(recyclarr_sync_job_duration_seconds_sum{namespace="$namespace", service=~"$service"}[$__rate_interval]) or label_replace(min_over_time(recyclarr_sync_job_duration_seconds_sum{namespace="$namespace", service=~"$service"}[$__rate_interval]) unless last_over_time(recyclarr_sync_job_duration_seconds_sum{namespace="$namespace", service=~"$service"}[1d] offset $__rate_interval), "first_sample", "true", "", "")) / sum by (recyclarr_sync_job_trigger) (increase(recyclarr_sync_job_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", service=~"$service"}[$__rate_interval]) or label_replace(min_over_time(recyclarr_sync_job_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", service=~"$service"}[$__rate_interval]) unless last_over_time(recyclarr_sync_job_duration_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", service=~"$service"}[1d] offset $__rate_interval), "first_sample", "true", "", ""))

panels.title: Requests to Sonarr and Radarr
panels.description: Requests by service address and response status, or the error when no response arrived

panels.title: Response time from Sonarr and Radarr (p95)
panels.description: Time until Sonarr and Radarr answer, for 95% of requests

panels.title: API requests
panels.description: Requests to the Recyclarr server API, for example from the CLI
